title: ContextLayer
description: Intelligent context infrastructure for AI teams: knowledge graph, sessions, tasks, documents.
summary: Intelligent context infrastructure for AI teams: knowledge graph, sessions, tasks, documents.
offersHint: Intelligent context infrastructure for AI teams: knowledge graph, sessions, tasks, documents. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.dotnova.io/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer JWT issued by ContextLayer (sign in at https://app.dotnova.io and copy the API token from Settings -> API Keys). Format: 'Bearer <token>'.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer JWT issued by ContextLayer (sign in at https://app.dotnova.io and copy the API token from Settings -> API Keys). Format: 'Bearer <token>'.

toolsPreview.name: accept_org_invite
toolsPreview.description: Accept a pending organization invite by organization name.

toolsPreview.name: add_task_dependency
toolsPreview.description: Add a dependency between tasks. Use this to express that a task is blocked by another task (must complete first) or relates to it. This prevents context contamination: when Task B depends on Task A, agents working on Task B will be warned if Task A is still in progress.

toolsPreview.name: add_team_member
toolsPreview.description: Add a member to a team. Find the team by name or ID, and the user by name or email.

toolsPreview.name: assign_task
toolsPreview.description: Assign a user to a task by name or email. The user is added to the task's assignees and linked in the knowledge graph.

toolsPreview.name: create_position
toolsPreview.description: Create a new job position/title in your organization (admin only).

toolsPreview.name: create_project
toolsPreview.description: Create a new project in your organization. You will be added as the project owner.

toolsPreview.name: create_sprint
toolsPreview.description: Create a new sprint for a project. Automatically migrates non-completed tasks (todo/in_progress) from the previous sprint. On first use, creates Sprint 0 (Backlog) for existing tasks and Sprint 1 as the active sprint.

toolsPreview.name: create_task
toolsPreview.description: Create a new task in a project. Tasks track work items and can be assigned to team members and linked to sessions.

toolsPreview.name: create_team
toolsPreview.description: Create a new team in your organization. You will be added as team lead.

toolsPreview.name: delete_document
toolsPreview.description: Delete a document from the knowledge base. This permanently removes the document.

toolsPreview.name: delete_position
toolsPreview.description: Delete a position permanently (admin only). Find by title or ID.

toolsPreview.name: delete_project
toolsPreview.description: Delete a project permanently (admin only). Find by name or ID.

toolsPreview.name: delete_task
toolsPreview.description: Delete a task permanently. The task and all its assignee links are removed.

toolsPreview.name: delete_team
toolsPreview.description: Delete a team permanently (admin only). Find by name or ID.

toolsPreview.name: delete_user
toolsPreview.description: Delete (soft-delete) a user from your organization (admin/owner only).

toolsPreview.name: end_session
toolsPreview.description: End a work session. This triggers context block generation — your activities are summarized and stored in the knowledge graph for future reference.

toolsPreview.name: find_documents
toolsPreview.description: Search documents in the organization's knowledge base. Filter by category, tags, project, or free-text query. Returns document metadata — use get_document to read the full content.

toolsPreview.name: get_context
toolsPreview.description: Get intelligent context from the knowledge graph. Pass a query describing what you need — the system will automatically route to the right data sources (tasks, sessions, documents, teams, blocks) based on intent analysis + graph traversal + semantic similarity. Optionally narrow scope with project name or session ID.

toolsPreview.name: get_context_routing
toolsPreview.description: Get the current context routing mode for the organization. Returns 'keyword_llm', 'keyword_only', or 'llm_only'.

toolsPreview.name: get_document
toolsPreview.description: Get the full content of a document by its ID. Use find_documents first to search, then get_document to read the content. For binary documents (PDFs, images), content is returned base64-encoded with encoding='base64' and the mime_type field.

toolsPreview.name: get_live_activity
toolsPreview.description: See what's happening right now: active sessions, recent events, traces, and tasks being worked on.

toolsPreview.name: get_my_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get your personal activity statistics: total sessions, events, active days, projects worked on, and recent activity summary.

toolsPreview.name: get_org_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get comprehensive organization statistics: counts, engagement metrics, task velocity.

toolsPreview.name: get_project_status
toolsPreview.description: Get the current status of a project including recent activity. You can use either the project name or ID.

toolsPreview.name: get_session_details
toolsPreview.description: Get full details of a session including all events/activities logged during it. Shows who did what, when, and the session block summary if available. Admins can view any session in the org; members can only view their own.

toolsPreview.name: get_team_details
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed information about a team: members (with roles), linked projects, and recent activity. Use team name or ID.

toolsPreview.name: invite_user
toolsPreview.description: Invite a new member to your organization (admin/owner only).

toolsPreview.name: link_task_session
toolsPreview.description: Link a work session to a task. This records that the session was used to work on the task, connecting them in the knowledge graph.

toolsPreview.name: link_team_project
toolsPreview.description: Link a project to a team. Find both by name or ID.

toolsPreview.name: list_colleagues
toolsPreview.description: List colleagues in your organization. Shows name, email, role, and optionally filters by team. Admins see all users; members see users in their own teams.

toolsPreview.name: list_notifications
toolsPreview.description: List your notifications — task assignments, status changes, sprint updates, invites, and more. Returns unread notifications by default.

toolsPreview.name: list_pending_invites
toolsPreview.description: List pending organization invites for the current user.

toolsPreview.name: list_positions
toolsPreview.description: List all job positions/titles in your organization with member counts.

toolsPreview.name: list_project_members
toolsPreview.description: List all members involved in a project. Includes users who have sessions in the project and users from teams linked to the project.

toolsPreview.name: list_project_teams
toolsPreview.description: List teams linked to a project.

toolsPreview.name: list_projects
toolsPreview.description: List projects in your organization. No parameters needed — just call it to see all your projects.

toolsPreview.name: list_sessions
toolsPreview.description: List your recent work sessions. Optionally filter by project name or ID. Shows task type, status, and event count.

toolsPreview.name: list_sprints
toolsPreview.description: List sprints for a project. Shows sprint number, name, goal, status (current/completed), and task count.

toolsPreview.name: list_tasks
toolsPreview.description: List tasks. Filter by project, status (todo/in_progress/done/cancelled), sprint number, or show only your tasks. Shows title, status, priority, assignees, sprint, and linked sessions.

toolsPreview.name: list_teams
toolsPreview.description: List all teams in your organization. Shows team name, member count, project count, and description.

toolsPreview.name: log_activity
toolsPreview.description: Log an activity or event. If no session_id is provided, a session is automatically created or reused for the project. Just pass project_name and content — no need to start a session first.

toolsPreview.name: log_trace
toolsPreview.description: Log a granular agent action trace. High-frequency, no LLM processing.

toolsPreview.name: log_traces_batch
toolsPreview.description: Log multiple traces in a single batch.

toolsPreview.name: mark_notification_read
toolsPreview.description: Mark a notification as read, or mark all notifications as read at once.

toolsPreview.name: move_task_to_sprint
toolsPreview.description: Move a task to a different sprint. Specify the target sprint by number or ID.

toolsPreview.name: remove_task_dependency
toolsPreview.description: Remove a dependency between tasks. This unblocks the task from the other task.

toolsPreview.name: remove_team_member
toolsPreview.description: Remove a member from a team. Find the team by name or ID, and the user by name or email.

toolsPreview.name: remove_user_from_org
toolsPreview.description: Remove a user from the current organization without deleting their account. Admin/owner only.

toolsPreview.name: search_entities
toolsPreview.description: Search entities in the knowledge graph by name. Finds people, companies, documents, concepts, tools, etc. that have been mentioned in your activities.

toolsPreview.name: set_context_routing
toolsPreview.description: Set the context routing mode for the organization. Requires admin role. Options: 'keyword_llm' (balanced), 'keyword_only' (fastest), 'llm_only' (most accurate).

toolsPreview.name: setup_organization
toolsPreview.description: Set up your organization in one step (admin only). Use this for onboarding.

toolsPreview.name: start_session
toolsPreview.description: Start a work session. If a project is provided (project_name or project_id), the session is bound to it; if neither is provided, an unbound (projectless) session is created — useful when the work isn't tied to a specific project. Reuses an existing active session for the same scope (per-project, or one global projectless session per user). Task type: coding, review, planning, debugging, research, meeting, other.

toolsPreview.name: unassign_task
toolsPreview.description: Remove a user from a task's assignees.

toolsPreview.name: unlink_team_project
toolsPreview.description: Unlink a project from a team. Find both by name or ID.

toolsPreview.name: update_org
toolsPreview.description: Update your organization's details (owner only). Set name, description, business model, objectives, custom context for AI, or links.

toolsPreview.name: update_position
toolsPreview.description: Update a position's title, description, or permissions (admin only). Find by title or ID.

toolsPreview.name: update_project
toolsPreview.description: Update a project's name, description, or links. Find by name or ID.

toolsPreview.name: update_task
toolsPreview.description: Update a task's status, title, description, priority, or team assignment. Use this to move tasks through the workflow (todo -> in_progress -> done) or reassign to a team.

toolsPreview.name: update_team
toolsPreview.description: Update a team's name, description, or objectives. Find by name or ID.

toolsPreview.name: update_user
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing user's name, role, positions, or skills (admin/owner only).

toolsPreview.name: upload_document
toolsPreview.description: Upload a document to the organization's knowledge base. Documents can be templates, policies, contracts, procedures, guides, or references. They are indexed in the knowledge graph and automatically surfaced as context when relevant to a task. Supports both text and binary files: for binary files (PDFs, images, etc.), set is_base64=true and provide the content as a base64-encoded string, along with the appropriate mime_type (e.g. 'application/pdf', 'image/png'). Optionally set file_name for the original filename. Embeddings are generated automatically for search.

toolsPreview.name: whoami
toolsPreview.description: Get your profile, organization, projects, recent sessions, and top entities. This is the best starting point — call this first to understand what's available. No parameters needed.
